title: Synopsis W9126G26QA088
description_text: Synopsis W9126G26QA088, for Four (4) HOMA brand pumps, model GRP36/1/C. If your company is capable of providing the required Four (4) HOMA brand pumps, model GRP36/1/C, and would like to compete for this award, please contact the contracting specialist, John Wysocki by the synopsis closing date listed below. Contractors must be registered in SAM.GOV and show NAICS Code 423840 in FAR 52.219-1 Small Business Program Representations. Contractors must also complete a NIST SP 800-171 or Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) self-assessment in the Supplier Performance Risk System (SPRS) portal to be eligible for award.
